text:
Marta P.: Heads-up — after int8 bring-up for morningstar-v1 we see a BLEU regression on HK vertical + emoji/ZWJ spacing tests :eyes:

eval-bot: Regression alert: morningstar-v1 (int8) -> zh-yue-vertical_emoji_v2 BLEU -4.8 (2026-03-20T03:21Z). Details: https://console.redwood/ops/regressions/INF-4321

Cheng Li: Can you paste a minimal repro + the quant config and kernel info?

Marta P.: Repro (run in repo/evals):
```bash
python -m evals.run --model morningstar-v1 --quant int8 --testset hk_vertical_emoji_v2 --batch 16
```
Sample input (raw):
"香港🇭🇰
中文·注音"
Gold detok: "香港 🇭🇰
中文·注音"
Model int8 detok (example): "香港20?🇭🇰
中文·注20?音"  <-- shows invisible insertion around emoji/particle

Ravi Kumar: quick hypothesis: looks like an extra invisible token (ZWSP/U+200B) got introduced at tokenization or during detok. Any recent token-map or detok changes?

Marta P.: I checked token-map — no changes in subword merges last week. But runtime rolled `fused-kv-cache-v2` kernels on 03/19 (notes in infra channel). Starting bisect now.

Cheng Li: Can you dump the tokenizer ids for the sample (gold vs int8 run)? `tokenizer.encode(...)`

Marta P.: IDs dump:
```
# gold (python tokenizer.encode)
[316, 1024, 5, 4342]
# morningstar-v1 float32 (same tokenizer):
[316, 1024, 5, 4342]
# morningstar-v1 int8 (observed):
[316, 1024, 5, 3, 4342]
# 3 corresponds to control/unprintable token we suspect is U+200B/ZWSP
```
This reproduces in local CPU tokenizer too (so not purely runtime decoding).

Ravi Kumar: if the extra id maps to U+200B then detok will insert it and BLEU drops. Could be a normalization change in the tokenizer preproc (strip/canonicalize) or an unseen merge rule. Who touched tokenizer or tokenizer config?

Cheng Li: @Marta can you run the same sample with q8 and fp32 to see if quantization scales the effect (i.e., tokenization vs search bias)?

Marta P.: q8 and fp32 both show the extra id in the tokenizer step, but int8 beam search/score differences make the model prefer sequences with the insertion -> worse BLEU. So root cause looks tokenizer/preproc-related, but quantization amplifies quality delta.

eval-bot: Issue INF-4321 created and linked to regression alert.

Marta P.: Short-term mitigation: adding a post-detokenize sanitizer in the eval pipeline to strip U+200B while we triage. Patch in staging: `text = text.replace('​', '')`

Ravi Kumar: Can we instead add a canonicalization step in the tokenizer (normalize NFKC + remove ZWSP) rather than post-detok? Patch there will be cleaner long-term.

Cheng Li: I'll contact tokenizer owners and freeze kernel rollout until bisect finishes. Also adding a focused test for hk_vertical_emoji_v2 to the smoke suite.

Marta P.: Thanks — bisect running now. Will post a follow-up with the offending commit or token map diff. For now rollout hold + staging sanitizer.

Ravi Kumar: ok, thanks. :thumbsup:

Marta P.: FYI sample that fails attached to INF-4321 and to the PR for the staging fix.
